relationships.evidence_quote: After 4 weeks of treatment, the serum levels of NaV1.7 and CGRP were decreased compared with those before treatment

key_findings: Wrist-ankle acupuncture reduced pain, sleep disturbance, anxiety and depression scores in PHN patients with fewer adverse reactions than lidocaine plaster.
Serum NaV1.7 and CGRP fell more with acupuncture than with western medication.
